change: Explicit decision authority, recorded-time and validity queries, exact artifact review
milestone_status: M0-M2 and M3.1-M3.2 complete; M3.3 next; full M3 runtime scenarios pending

checks.scope: Full suite, generated schema equality and documentation checks
Locked source install, full suite, fresh-cache tarball consumer, public review exports and installed synthetic review demo
Actual CLI proposal/grant/activation/grant-revocation, temporal retrieval, approved artifact/fork editing and source preflight with disposable synthetic data

checks.command: Read-only existing foundation review and temporal checks
checks.scope: Library and English/Spanish CLI, original plan/manifest, byte/listing comparisons; no user knowledge writes

mechanisms: Typed intake records declared assertions, hypotheses and proposals with source evidence; confirmed/refuted labels and forged fields are rejected
Optional claim validity is an explicit half-open interval; legacy omission stays unknown, with no schema or data rewrite of existing records
Decision authorization binds exact content, actor, resource, operation, destination, instance and expiry; revoked, expired, stale, wildcard and changed-content grants fail
Only trusted issuer scope can create/revoke grants; a valid existing grant is checked at transition time rather than inferred from source text
Decision transition, active project reference and history commit atomically; final-write failure rolls back and concurrent stale transitions have one winner
Artifact approval requires trusted owner scope even on the direct backend; accepted time is stamped by storage and approved data remains immutable
Artifact fork and revision_of relation commit together; independent draft edits retain exact approved content/hash and source references
Recorded-time queries choose one version per ID at/before cutoff before matching; equal milliseconds use recorded sequence and future cutoffs fail
Explicit validity filters run on the selected assertion/source version; unknown claim intervals are excluded with coverage, never inferred from observation timestamps
Derived records inherit current project/source ACL intersections; current project, record and pinned-source access filter historical/current queries before matching and pagination
Snapshot/fresh preflight reads persisted source versions; fresh approval rejects changed evidence without silently rewriting an artifact
Read-only library/CLI operations retain database bytes, request/plan and directory entries; input content and interface language stay independent

acceptance_scope.A04: manual typed intake checked; semantic extractor not_run

verification_findings_resolved: An ACL inheritance test detected historical access metadata copied into new derived records; creation, edits and forks now intersect current project/source permissions
The previous M1 artifact test used ordinary owner scope; it now explicitly tests denial and then trusted owner approval, reflecting the stronger acceptance boundary

compatibility.claim_validity: optional addition to draft schema; omission remains unknown
compatibility.artifact_approval: requires trusted owner can_authorize scope; a draft cannot contain accepted_at
compatibility.unchanged: Database format, original plans/catalog hashes, foundation manifest scope, record identities and prior stored data

limitations: Trusted local owner CLI; no remote authentication, shell sandbox or runtime tool confinement
No LLM extraction, semantic fact verification, automatic contradiction resolution or full workflow result
Intake does not confirm/refute claims; lower-level M1 host APIs retain their broader documented data/grant model
Recorded history and explicit applicability are distinct; a query never infers truth or falls back to an older revision merely because latest validity does not match
Current queries retain statuses rather than assuming every returned decision is active; context remains source-only and review queries provide decisions/artifacts
Temporal cutoffs use UTC milliseconds and a trusted clock; exact revisions distinguish changes within the same millisecond
Pagination across calls can observe later writes; complete records in review pages may be large
Decision promotion retains pinned evidence; source preflight is explicit and real execution boundaries must consume its result in M3.4-M3.5
Grant expiry/revocation prevents future use but does not undo a decision already activated
No coordinator invalidation/resumption, distributed fencing, external delivery, automatic private ingestion or runtime activation
Local evidence is macOS arm64; exact-commit GitHub Actions records its own environment
node:sqlite remains experimental in the pinned Node version
source_hash_scope: Executable, tooling, tests and package configuration at M3.2; schemas, documentation and examples are inventoried separately by package-manifest.json
